prompt: Which snippet safely reads an integer from stdin, recovering from non-integer input?
choices: Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); int n = sc.nextInt();
Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); while (!sc.hasNextInt()) sc.next(); int n = sc.nextInt();
explanation: Discarding non-integer tokens with sc.next() in a loop until sc.hasNextInt() is true prevents InputMismatchException. Option B crashes on bad input. Option A reads a raw byte (not a full number). Option D reads a single byte, not an int.
